Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax)

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax) is the most premium executive bus in the fleet: twenty-seven plush leather seats, each one reclining on its own, on a wood floor, with room for forty bags.

About the Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax)

Ambient interior lighting, an extremely comfortable custom sound system with a subwoofer, and tinted windows.

The coach for corporate groups, airport runs, weddings and company events, and anything else that moves a lot of people in comfort.

Seats: Plush leather seats, each reclining on its own

Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax) rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $225 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $550. Seats 27, room for 40 bags.
